prompt_fields.subject: A hulking demon standing on four thick clawed limbs, its hide a mottled dark rust-brown with patches of ashen grey decay, a ridge of short curved horns along its skull and clusters of small secondary eyes glowing dull red along its flanks.
prompt_fields.contrast: Second demon/major catalog identity alongside kryl-feijan (a roiling pale-grey smoke mass with clawed reaching arms and no solid quadrupedal body). Lithfengel is a solid-bodied clawed quadrupedal beast, not smoke -- silhouette (four-legged hulking beast vs. an upright teardrop of smoke) and value/hue (mottled rust-brown-and-ash decay vs. kryl-feijan's pale storm-grey) keep the two demon/major entries unmistakably apart.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Mottled dark rust-brown hide with patches of ashen grey decay and cracked texture, short dull curved horns, small dull-red glowing secondary eyes along the flanks as the only warm accent; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's hide so the two never merge.
